findings.description: The explicit action Goal fragment 'メール通知を停止し' was classified context in all10 admitted assessments. Given the full Goal, treating the requested stop action solely as subject/background/constraints is questionable.

findings.expected: Preserve the action obligation of the full literal Goal; absence of a visible result can be not_shown rather than erasing the obligation into context.
